notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; business-type on accrual (as FY2023/FY2024). MISSING PAGE: the trim holds only the left half of the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (p5: General, Street, Sales Tax, CDA columns); the right half with the Economic Development, Grant, Other Governmental and Total Governmental Funds columns (report page 19) is not in the trim. Governmental statement lines, totals and transfers are therefore computed as the sum of the 7 fund columns: p5 columns + Economic Development Fund (budget schedule p18) + Grant Fund (p19) + Total Nonmajor (combining statement p20), all marked computed. The sums tie: total revenues 3,201,957, expenditures 3,481,711, net transfers 319,916 (= Statement of Activities p3), and several lines equal the Statement of Activities general revenues (property 340,763, investment income 14,505, miscellaneous 54,656, lottery 51,247). Economic Development 'Sales proceeds' 19,661 assumed to be in the statement's Sales/insurance proceeds row. Beginning fund balance 2,480,153 derived from the fund columns (ending printed 2,520,315 on the Balance Sheet p4). Roll-forward: 2,480,153 + 3,201,957 - 3,481,711 + 795,349 - 475,433 = 2,520,315. Cash not recorded at the top level (as FY2023/FY2024; cash, county treasurer cash and restricted cash/CDs are on the balance sheet). Business-type from the proprietary statement Total column (pp8-9): receipts = operating revenues + nonoperating interest, grant revenue, gain on sale and miscellaneous income (computed; no single printed total); disbursements 4,595,463 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 4,584,335 + interest 8,021 + loan fees 3,107; transfers (319,916). 15,762,712 + 5,625,668 - 4,595,463 - 319,916 = 16,473,001. Operating 'Other revenue' 179,098 is charges for services (Statement of Activities counts it there). Allocated administrative expenses net to zero in the Total column (not recorded). Proprietary cash-flow statement (pp10-12) not recorded (as FY2023/FY2024). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1; component units excluded). Street, Sales Tax, CDA, Economic Development and Grant funds from their budget schedules (pp15-19; lines with no actual amount omitted); nonmajor funds per fund (p20). No enterprise fund schedules.
